Title: Anaplan Model Builder
Description: About Slalom’s Enterprise Capability At the heart of Slalom’s Enterprise Capability is a bold ambition: to design and deliver intelligent, human-centered business applications that empower organizations to serve their customers with acceleration, agility, precision, and purpose. We partner with leading platforms—Salesforce, ServiceNow, Adobe, Anaplan, Workday, Contentful, Boomi, Workato and more—to build scalable, end-to-end solutions that unify data, streamline operations, and unlock actionable insights. Our work powers everything from smarter CRM experiences and next-gen commerce sites to resilient case management systems and optimized workforce planning. But we're not just technologists—we’re strategic enablers. Whether helping a client modernize their infrastructure, integrate mission-critical functions, or activate AI-powered innovation, we connect strategy to execution in ways that drive measurable impact. Here, you’ll collaborate with curious, courageous people who believe in growth through experimentation, delivering value through partnerships, and building a future where technology works quietly in service of extraordinary outcomes. Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, we’re continuing to grow our Anaplan practice in LATAM, expanding the team and capabilities we can bring to clients across the region and globally. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing practice, work alongside experienced Anaplan professionals, and help shape how we deliver Anaplan solutions from LATAM. What You’ll Do Translate existing solutions, complex spreadsheets, and business challenges into elegant and intuitive Anaplan multidimensional models. Design, build, and enhance Anaplan models as part of new implementations, connected solutions, optimizations, or expanded functionality. Partner with clients and internal teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Anaplan solutions. Provide clear, meaningful feedback and timely progress updates to business partners and project teams. Develop and maintain model documentation. Participate in data integration and migration activities. Support and lead UAT testing and deployment activities. Collaborate with the broader Anaplan team and contribute to the continued growth of Slalom’s Anaplan capabilities in LATAM. What You’ll Bring Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, MIS, or a related field. 3+ years of experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions, including at least one Anaplan implementation. Hands-on experience designing, building, or implementing Anaplan models. Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills. Understanding of system implementation methodologies, including requirements gathering, design, build, testing, and deployment. Experience with Agile methodologies is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills . A collaborative, client-focused approach and commitment to service excellence. Subject matter expertise in planning and modeling within Supply Chain, Finance, or Sales is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of inbound and outbound data integrations. Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. A hands-on, “roll-up-your-sleeves” mindset and enthusiasm for working within a growing team. Interest in gaining exposure across industries while continuing to develop your Anaplan and consulting expertise. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Title: Engineering & Quality - Software Engineer, Senior
Description: Fitch Group is currently seeking a Lead Data Engineer based out of our Monterey, Mexico office. As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. Fitch's Technology & Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a “Best Place to Work in Technology” 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference. Want to learn more about a career in technology and data at Fitch? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology-and-Data/ About The Team Join the Data Marketplace Tech team within the CSO organization—a highly visible group responsible for designing, building, and scaling solutions that free up data and empower business decisions across Fitch. The team collaborates closely with stakeholders across the organization to deliver next-generation data capabilities with a focus on faster time to market, data engineering, robust data controls, innovation, and leveraging AI/ML for data solutions. How You’ll Make An Impact Design, build, test, and deploy scalable data pipelines, APIs, and data products that support business, analytics, and AI-driven use cases. Act as a hands-on technical lead, contributing directly to coding, SQL development, testing, troubleshooting, and production support while ensuring high-quality delivery. Develop robust solutions across data lakes, data warehouses, and governed data environments, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Work on LLM-based developer tools, prompt-enabled workflows, conversational search, RAG pipelines, vector databases, MCP-based integrations, or other tooling that supports intelligent automation and agentic use cases. Partner with business, analytics, and AI/ML teams to deliver data solutions aligned to enterprise priorities, including support for Agentic AI tools and platforms, intelligent automation, and AI-ready data workflows. Lead technical design, delivery planning, and coordination across multiple initiatives, while mentoring junior engineers and promoting strong engineering, DevOps, and DataOps practices. Establish and enforce data engineering standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability, and operational support to improve platform stability and delivery consistency. Drive continuous improvement of data architecture, pipeline efficiency, and reusable engineering patterns to enable faster delivery and better scalability across enterprise data initiatives. You May Be a Good Fit If 5 – 8 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data platform development, ideally within financial services or another regulated industry. Expertise in SQL and Python, including experience building APIs, data pipelines, transformation frameworks, and production-grade data solutions. Experience in designing and supporting solutions on AWS as the preferred cloud platform, with familiarity in similar cloud environments, and hands-on experience with containerization, especially Kubernetes/EKS, as well as serverless services such as AWS Lambda and event-driven architectures. Experience in working with Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Data Governance, and Data Mesh concepts, along with modern engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, Agile delivery. 1-2 years of AI-enabled engineering or data tooling, such as LLM-based developer tools, prompt-enabled workflows, semantic search, RAG pipelines, vector databases, MCP-based integrations, or other tooling that supports intelligent automation and agentic use cases. Comfortable in leading technical workstreams, collaborating across cross-functional teams, and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out Experience with Collibra and related data governance, metadata management, catalog, lineage, and data quality tools. Exposure to Databricks and Snowflake for modern data engineering and analytics use cases. Familiarity with trino or similar distributed query and data mesh platforms. Awareness of or hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and platforms, as well as AI/data capabilities such as knowledge graphs, semantic search, LLM-powered applications, GPT, Amazon Q, and Microsoft Copilot. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills, with a proven ability to deliver high-quality solutions in cross-functional environments. Why Choose Fitch Work-Life Balance First: 40% in-office monthly stay connected while keeping flexibility. A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work. Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.
